documented_behavior:
CircleCI's January 2023 incident report states that malware on an engineer's laptop enabled theft of a valid 2FA-backed SSO session, after which the actor escalated access to a subset of production systems.
The same report states that exfiltrated material included customer environment variables, tokens, and encryption keys.
mapping_assumptions:
AIT does not ingest CircleCI production telemetry. This fixture is a researcher-constructed exchange pair that models excess production secret retrieval as an undeclared endpoint under /reconstruction/.
Customer environment variables / tokens / keys are represented as synthetic sensitive markers (environment_variable, access_token, encryption_key) rather than real secret values.
The mutated phase adds the excess-scope secret retrieval path to model post-compromise behavior relative to a constrained baseline allowlist.

findings.evidence: Observed endpoint /reconstruction/excess-scope/production-secrets but it was not declared as expected.
findings.expected_behavior: Integration should stay within the declared endpoint allowlist.
findings.observed_behavior: Observed endpoint /reconstruction/excess-scope/production-secrets but it was not declared as expected.
findings.remediation_note: Reduce granted scopes and remove undeclared endpoint calls.
findings.title: Hidden endpoint access detected

findings.evidence: Additional endpoints were reached during the mutated run.
findings.expected_behavior: State changes should not unlock extra undeclared data access.
findings.remediation_note: Inspect state-dependent branches and scope checks in the integration.
findings.title: Mutated execution exposed additional behavior

findings.evidence: Response from /reconstruction/excess-scope/production-secrets contained a configured sensitive marker.
findings.expected_behavior: Sensitive marker fields should not be retrieved unless explicitly approved.
findings.remediation_note: Restrict the integration to minimum necessary fields and revalidate scopes.
findings.title: Sensitive marker accessed
